provenance: Fictional multilingual hackathon fixture. Every alias, animal, colony, message and photo is invented. Broad neighborhood labels provide demo context only; no real animal locations, contacts or private chat data are included.

fixtureGuide.scenario: 72-report weekend dispatch, four connected rounds across 18 fictional colonies.
fixtureGuide.catCatalogPurpose: Explicit fictional profile metadata, not model-generated identity evidence. New profiles have no photo; known photos are clearly marked earlier fixture images.
fixtureGuide.rawCompanionBoundary: The raw parsers preserve messages, source traces, attached fixture photos and broad areas. They recognize a small fixed set of demo cats; new names and expanded colony keys in these raw chats remain unmatched for human review. The structured replay carries their explicit synthetic identity/colony proposals.
expectedHumanActions: Clarify kitten counts before verifying totals
Review Guava/Coco duplicate candidates side by side; no automatic merge
Confirm search/missing/reunion and medical outcomes separately
Assign the evening feeder offer; a chat offer is not a completed visit

records.text: DEMO Little Havana · Flagler Yard: Poppy, the split-face calico, came out for breakfast, ate a little, then settled in shade. Count 6 adults; feed complete, water refreshed. Same fictional photo from the earlier report attached for context.
DEMO Little Havana · Mango Court: Guava ya vino por su desayuno, bien puntual. Conté 5 adultos y dejé agua fresca. Feed complete ✅
DEMO Little River · Laundry Commons: Marmalade is here with the breakfast crew. Fed 7, bowls cleaned. Reattaching the earlier fictional image, not a new photo.
DEMO Little River · Palm Shade: Biscuit e Luna chegaram juntos. Vi 4 adultos, comida e água ok; feed complete. Bom turno, gente.
DEMO North Miami · Canal Commons: Miso ap manje trankil. Mwen konte 5 gran chat, dlo pwòp disponib. Feed complete, mesi ekip.
DEMO North Miami · Garden Steps: Pebble checked in, but no feeder is confirmed for this evening. Count 4 adults now; can a coordinator assign the later shift?
DEMO North Miami · Oak Commons: Willow and Juniper waited at the shaded bowl. Count 6; feed complete. Leaving the path clear for everyone.
DEMO Fort Lauderdale · Riverwalk Commons: Tux showed up late as usual, white paws first 😅 Fed 5, water refreshed. Earlier fictional Tux image attached for context.
DEMO Fort Lauderdale · Citrus Court: Tamarind comeu bem. Conte 4 adultos, água trocada e feed complete. Hoje fiquei só na área pública.
DEMO Miami Beach · Shade Bowl: Skipper did the breakfast loop. Count 4, feed complete. The demo tag animation is not a real location update.
DEMO Miami Beach · Palm Walk: Sombra llegó calladita. Vi 5 adultos; feed complete y agua a la sombra. Marina estaba cerca también.
DEMO Miami Beach · Breeze Court: Pearl bò kote bòl la; Echo te vini apre. Mwen konte 3 gran chat. Feed complete, dlo fre la.
DEMO Hialeah · Lime Commons: Coal made his entrance after everybody else. Fed 6 adults; ear-tip still not verified, please keep TNR review pending.
DEMO Hialeah · Lime Court: Lime came out, Button stayed back. Count 4 adults, feed complete. I watched from public access and left quietly.
DEMO Homestead · Dry Commons: Mango e Olive comeram. Vi 5 adultos, feed complete. A parte baixa está molhada; não entrei.
DEMO Homestead · Mango Shade: Papaya came for food. Count 3 adults; feed complete and bowls washed. Fig watched from the shade.
DEMO Hollywood / Broward · Grove Commons: Sunny y Velvet llegaron juntos hoy. Count 4, feed complete. Está tranquilo por ahora.
DEMO Hollywood / Broward · Patio Commons: Mocha manje byen, Clover la tou. Mwen konte 5 gran chat; feed complete. M ap kite yon nòt pou pwochen ekip la.
DEMO Little Havana · Flagler Yard: Domino is holding up a hind paw and only took a few bites. I kept my distance. Please make this an injury review for the coordinator.
DEMO Little Havana · Mango Court: Pepper parece tener la barriga más grande. Puede ser embarazo, pero yo no puedo confirmar. Pregnancy review please; sin tocarla.
DEMO Little River · Laundry Commons: Coco was behind the group. Maybe 2 tiny young cats heard under cover, not safely visible. Keep the range 0–2 and ask someone to clarify.
DEMO Little River · Palm Shade: Luna espirrou várias vezes e deixou a comida. Não sei a causa; illness review por favor. Fiquei observando de longe.
DEMO North Miami · Canal Commons: Nori pa vini bò bòl la. Mwen tande ti chat, petèt 3, men mwen pa wè yo. Maybe 3 kittens; pa antre pou verifye.
DEMO North Miami · Garden Steps: Zuri did not appear during my quiet ten-minute check. That is only a negative check; please ask before any missing-status change.
DEMO North Miami · Oak Commons: Juniper looks new to me; I cannot confirm an ear tip. Please add a new-cat/TNR review, not a procedure booking.
DEMO Fort Lauderdale · Riverwalk Commons: Anchor walked past the usual bowl toward loud traffic. I stopped at public access. Traffic note, not an exact animal pin.
DEMO Fort Lauderdale · Citrus Court: Kiwi está mancando e evitando apoiar a pata. Injury review; não tentei pegar nem chegar perto.
DEMO Miami Beach · Shade Bowl: Coral stayed in cover as the heat picked up. Maybe 4 or 5 adults total; my view was partly blocked.
DEMO Miami Beach · Palm Walk: Marina no llegó en esta vuelta. No la marquen missing por este mensaje; solo solicito una revisión y otra observación segura.
DEMO Miami Beach · Breeze Court: Echo gen nen k ap koule epi li pa manje anpil. Mwen pa ka di sa li genyen. Illness review pou kowòdonatè a.
DEMO Hialeah · Lime Commons: Chispa looked rounder than last week. Possible pregnancy, not confirmed; please flag for a coordinator to review the evidence.
DEMO Hialeah · Lime Court: Button came close enough for a side view. Ear tip unknown; new-cat candidate and TNR review. No handling.
DEMO Homestead · Dry Commons: Olive ficou do outro lado da água parada. Eu parei. Flood access note; nenhuma busca pela área alagada.
DEMO Homestead · Mango Shade: Fig is taking shorter steps and has a visible scrape. Injury review please; I did not handle or diagnose him.
DEMO Hollywood / Broward · Grove Commons: Velvet estaba con dos pequeños, quizá tres. No pude contarlos bien. Young-cat welfare review; range 2–3 until a safe check.
DEMO Hollywood / Broward · Patio Commons: Clover pa touche manje a jodi a. Not eating, tanpri fè yon illness review; mwen pa fè okenn dyagnostik.
DEMO Little Havana · Flagler Yard: Poppy ate again on the second pass. I did not assess Domino’s paw. Keeping the earlier welfare review open; no medical outcome from this note.
DEMO Little Havana · Mango Court: Guava se movió entre las dos áreas de Little Havana. La vi desde el paso público, sin perseguirla. Otra observación, misma ficha propuesta.
DEMO Little River · Laundry Commons: Marmalade came back for water. New fictional alternate-view photo attached for coordinator comparison; Coco stayed under cover. No handling.
DEMO Little River · Palm Shade: Biscuit apareceu de novo, Luna ficou quieta. Feed complete para o grupo; não é confirmação de melhora da Luna.
DEMO North Miami · Canal Commons: Miso te retounen bò dlo a. Mwen pa wè Nori klè; pa gen foto ni prèv idantite nan mesaj sa a.
DEMO North Miami · Garden Steps: Pebble’s evening coverage was offered by Demo Nia. Coordinator still needs to assign it; this message alone does not complete a visit.
DEMO North Miami · Oak Commons: Willow ate with the group on another pass. Fed 6 and water refreshed. Juniper’s TNR status remains for human review.
DEMO Fort Lauderdale · Riverwalk Commons: Tux visible on the public-side path this pass. Please compare this sighting with the earlier search case; do not mark reunited automatically.
DEMO Fort Lauderdale · Citrus Court: Tamarind está na sombra, sem aproximação. A observação de Kiwi segue para revisão humana; não confirmo recuperação.
DEMO Miami Beach · Shade Bowl: Skipper passed near the fictional Palm Walk colony as well. Same cat proposal, second colony association; no live GPS claim.
DEMO Miami Beach · Palm Walk: Sombra salió después del ruido. Feeding complete para 5 adultos; Marina no se vio en mi tramo. Ese dato no prueba ausencia.
DEMO Miami Beach · Breeze Court: Pearl te vini ankò pou dlo. Mwen rete sou chemen piblik la. Nou bezwen yon moun verifye kondisyon Echo anvan pwochen deplasman.
DEMO Hialeah · Lime Commons: Coal was seen again after the earlier pass. Count 6 adults; feeding complete. Leave the ear-tip uncertainty in the record.
DEMO Hialeah · Lime Court: Lime crossed between two fictional Hialeah colony areas. Quiet observation only; one cat can have more than one colony association.
DEMO Homestead · Dry Commons: Mango comeu na segunda passagem. Feeding complete para 5; a rota com água parada continua sem acesso verificado.
DEMO Homestead · Mango Shade: Papaya came for water. Count 3 adults; feeding complete. Fig’s earlier scrape still needs the coordinator’s review.
DEMO Hollywood / Broward · Grove Commons: Sunny salió cuando bajó el ruido. Feeding complete para 4 adultos; no pude confirmar el número de pequeños con Velvet.
DEMO Hollywood / Broward · Patio Commons: Mocha tounen ankò. Feeding complete pou 5 gran chat. Nòt sou Clover la toujou bezwen swivi moun, pa gen rezilta medikal konfime.
DEMO Little Havana · Flagler Yard: Domino stayed near cover. Count 6 adults from the public side; no close exam. Passing the injury review to the next coordinator.
DEMO Little Havana · Mango Court: Tal vez sea Guava, pero esta vista parcial no basta. Different observer, separate candidate key until someone checks both records; possible duplicate.
DEMO Little River · Laundry Commons: Talvez seja Coco de novo; vi só parte do rosto. Another observer, possible duplicate. Keep a separate candidate; never merge automatically.
DEMO Little River · Palm Shade: Luna’s bowl was untouched when I left. Please leave the illness review visible in handoff; I cannot verify whether she ate later.
DEMO North Miami · Canal Commons: Nori pa parèt sou dènye pas mwen an. Gen moun ki tande ti chat toujou. Keep kittens count uncertain; pa antre anba okenn bilding.
DEMO North Miami · Garden Steps: Zuri appeared for a moment on the public-side path. New sighting only; coordinator compares it with the prior negative check.
DEMO North Miami · Oak Commons: Juniper has a pale tail tip and a small shoulder patch. Logging markings for review; no photo today and no identity claim.
DEMO Fort Lauderdale · Riverwalk Commons: Anchor was not in view on the final pass. Negative search check logged from a safe path, not proof that a cat left the colony.
DEMO Fort Lauderdale · Citrus Court: Kiwi não veio ao pote desta vez. Mantém injury review para a coordenação. Não entrei em área restrita para procurar.
DEMO Miami Beach · Shade Bowl: Coral came out for water. Count 4 now. Water is shaded, but this does not resolve the earlier count uncertainty by itself.
DEMO Miami Beach · Palm Walk: Marina apareció a distancia, con el grupo. Nueva observación para revisar; nadie debe cerrar el caso sin confirmar identidad.
DEMO Miami Beach · Breeze Court: Echo rete lwen bòl la. Mwen kite nòt ak lè pou pwochen ekip la. Illness review toujou ouvè; pa gen dyagnostik.
DEMO Hialeah · Lime Commons: Chispa stayed in shade. Feeding complete for the group, count 6. Pregnancy review remains open; no trapping decision was made here.
DEMO Hialeah · Lime Court: Button was seen near the second Hialeah colony’s public-side area too. Same proposed cat, extra colony association, no forced home-colony change.
DEMO Homestead · Dry Commons: Olive foi vista de longe, sem atravessar água. Acesso segue inseguro; aguardar revisão humana da rota antes de designar busca.
DEMO Homestead · Mango Shade: Fig came close to the water then returned to cover. Earlier injury review stays open; handing off to the next shift.
DEMO Hollywood / Broward · Grove Commons: Velvet y los pequeños se quedaron bajo sombra. Maybe 3 tiny young cats, pero no vista completa. No cierro la revisión con este mensaje.
DEMO Hollywood / Broward · Patio Commons: Clover pran de bouch manje sèlman. Illness review rete ouvè pou kowòdonatè a. Pa gen okenn tretman oswa rezilta otomatik.
